name: After § 43
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 43c. Calls for Parliament’s public procurement contracts to include stringent social criteria, particularly regarding remuneration, job security, occupational health and safety, and compliance with applicable collective agreements, and for their implementation to be subject to effective monitoring; calls for any decision to outsource services or renew a service contract to be preceded by a transparent assessment of the total cost, including the costs of monitoring, contract management and staff turnover, as well as the impact on working conditions, service quality and continuity of operations; calls for that assessment to be communicated to Parliament’s competent bodies before any decision to outsource is taken;
